review.conclusion_reason: YES depends on the unverified cutoff-date citation. The confirmed 2025 citation supports the asserted type of evidence but does not independently establish its currency on October 14, 2026. The limited formal-status finding is consistent with the checked OFR entry. Pending verification, operative status is OPEN: obtain the dated part 23 authority citation or another current source treating EO 10707 as operative.
review.stop_code_verdict: wrong (WEB fits the unresolved cutoff-source verification). The project rules expressly allow a current CFR citation treating the order as in force; the evidence slice identifies exactly that predicate and reports no post-cutoff change. NEEDS_RULING is not established merely because the regulatory text concerns the emblem. The dated citation must first be verified.

verdicts.reason: The named held Federal Register OCR contains the quoted approval sentence, legibly, at 22 FR 3211.
The held original contains the quoted incorporation language and heraldic description within its recital; these define the seal approved by the operative sentence.
The held EO 11319 printing expressly substitutes the second paragraph of EO 10707 and is dated December 9, 1966. It contains no revocation.
Comparison of both held originals confirms that the replacement repeats the description through 'gold rope rim' and omits the sentence identifying the central device as the emblem.
The cited cutoff-date XML and the evidence slice's dated HTML page were inaccessible. The finding-aid snippet is only a lead and cannot independently verify the cutoff-date claim.

The XML was inaccessible, but the corresponding official annual PDF confirms the exact authority line on printed page 98: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CFR-2025-title33-vol1/pdf/CFR-2025-title33-vol1-part23.pdf.
The cited National Archives page's EO 10707 entry lists 'Amended by: EO 11319, December 9, 1966' and no revocation or supersession.
The cited cutoff-date text could not be retrieved. The 2025 annual PDF corroborates the emblem quotation and absence of seal language in part 23, but cannot verify the specified 2026 version.
